stem.text: The graph shows how the rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction depends on the concentration of substrate.

stem.alt: Graph of initial rate of reaction in mmol s^-1 against substrate concentration in mmol dm^-3, with axes from 0.0 to 0.4 and 0.0 to 5.0, on a grid. The curve rises and then levels off.

stem.text: What is the Michaelis-Menten constant ($K_\text{m}$) for this enzyme under these conditions?
